sam: hi all, sam here — first day! trying to build runtime on Ubuntu 22.04 with an A100. cmake finished but link fails: 

sam: ```
[100%] Linking CXX executable bin/redwood_runtime
/usr/bin/ld: undefined reference to `cublasLtCreate'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

sam: nvcc -> 11.8, driver 535. who should i loop in for infra/driver stuff? @jamie @riley

jamie: welcome :wave: likely mismatch where cmake found headers but not libs. quick checks: 
- `readlink -f /usr/local/cuda` to ensure symlink points to cuda-11.8
- `ls /usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64 | grep cublasLt`
- try our dev container `docker run --gpus all -it --rm -v $PWD:/src redwood/runtime-dev:cuda11.8`

riley: also run `ldd bin/redwood_runtime | grep cublas` and `sudo ldconfig`. If driver changed recently, reinstalling driver and kernel headers helps: `sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r)` then reinstall driver.

infra-bot: CI Notice: PR #3492 runtime-build failed on link step — logs: https://ci.internal/3492

sam: tried the container and set `-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-11.8` and exported `LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-11.8/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH`. after cmake/make the link succeeded. thanks!

jamie: nice, added a note to docs/dev-setup.md about stray cuda symlinks. ping if you want pairing on smoke tests.

sam: will do — marking resolved for now :)
